Here are some of the variables you may want to change:
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
Users have reported that values up to 80 worked well for them.
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz.
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!

===== Pinwheel: 512x16 IHP SRAM macro as the unified memory (src/pw_mem.v) =====
Selects the macro instead of the flop array in pw_mem.v.
Macro files are vendored from IHP-Open-PDK 2bbec755 (the commit tt-gds-action installs),
see macro/RM_IHPSG13_1P_512x16_c2_bm_bist/README.md. Pattern from urish/ttihp-sram-test.
Placed so PDN stripes land on the macro's own power straps (see the PDN notes below).
Instance name is the flattened Yosys path; the PDN script requires orientation R0.
PDN on CMOS5L: user blocks stop at Metal4 and the SRAM's VDD!/VDDARRAY!/VSS! pins are
vertical Metal4 straps, so the macro is powered by PDN stripes that run straight over
same-net straps. Stripe centres are 2.88+10+50k (VPWR) and +2.1+3.05 (VGND); with the
macro at x=307.355 the stripes at 412.88/418.03 cover its full-height VDD!/VSS! straps and
the one at 312.88 covers a VDDARRAY! strap from above. PDN_OBSTRUCTIONS cut every other
stripe over the macro + 10 um halo. Checked by scripts/check_tt_config.py.
IR-drop analysis checks every SRAM power strap as a separate node and cannot see that the
straps are tied together inside the macro, so it fails on the straps no stripe covers
(PSM-0069, GDS runs 2 and 3; every flagged shape was a macro strap). LVS checks the real
connection, so skip this report-only step.
SRAM GDS has no PR boundary layer; read full GDS instead of blackbox
SRAM macro internals trigger massive DRC in Magic; skip (KLayout DRC also skipped)
Blackbox SRAM macros during SPICE extraction for LVS, as the macros are not LVS clean
